summary: Asserts that a condition holds, throwing when it does not.
description: For the checks that are about the moment rather than the arguments: a connection that is already closed, a sheet that has not been prepared yet, a value that was supposed to be cached by now.
It is declared as a TypeScript assertion, so after the call the compiler treats the condition as true for the rest of the function.

params.message: The message of the exception. A default is used when omitted.

returns: nothing; it either passes or throws.

examples.title: Guarding a state
